title: Etale descent of regular intersections and codimension
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $D_1,\ldots,D_n\hookrightarrow X$ be closed subschemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], and for $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ write $D_J=\mathop{\times}_{j\in J,X}D_j$ for the scheme-theoretic intersection (with $D_\varnothing=X$). Suppose that for every point $x\in X$ and every $J$ there are an étale morphism $v:W\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] and a point $w\in W$ over $x$ such that, with $R=\mathcal O_{W,w}$, the local scheme $D_J\times_X\operatorname{Spec}R$ is regular and every irreducible component of it has codimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] $|J|$ in $\operatorname{Spec}R$. Then every $D_J$ is regular and every irreducible component of $D_J$ has codimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] $|J|$ in $X$.

mathlib_searches.query: For an étale map of Noetherian local rings, regularity is equivalent for source and target, and local dimensions are equal.
mathlib_searches.results: Returned IsEtale and RingHom.Etale declarations but no regularity/codimension theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: Regularity and codimension of a closed subscheme can be checked on an étale covering of a locally Noetherian scheme.
mathlib_searches.results: Returned IsEtale and smoothness declarations, but no regular-intersection descent theorem.
Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Etale.lean lines 23, 99, 108 mention only etale/smooth equivalence; no regularity theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: Pointwise étale local criterion: regularity and codimension of every scheme-theoretic intersection can be checked in local rings at étale points over each base point.
mathlib_searches.results: Returned RingHom.Etale.propertyIsLocal and étale/smoothness declarations; no regularity or codimension descent theorem.
Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Etale.lean lines 23, 99, 108 mention only étale/smooth equivalence; no regularity or codimension theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: At every point, regularity and codimension of a closed subscheme intersection descend from the local ring at an étale point above that point.
mathlib_searches.results: Returned generic étale descent and RingHom.Etale declarations; no theorem for regularity and codimension of closed intersections.
